excerpts.excerpt: LLM agents can exceed their authorization boundaries while pursuing user goals without an adversary.
each pairing a sufficient compliant path with an attractive unauthorized shortcut
Drift is persistent and dominated by early data over-collection
agents must face useful but unauthorized actions while retaining a feasible way to complete the task within bounds
persisting or re-planning beyond the intended execution window
accessing data clearly beyond what the task requires

claims.text: Across 13 LLMs and three frameworks (25,207 trajectories)
86.18% of tasks admit an observed clean-success trajectory
93.5% of legally grounded drifting runs map to multiple jurisdictions

not_results_of_this_sketch: The grants, tasks, trajectories and every fixture outcome are synthetic. Nothing here reproduces or measures any model, framework, benchmark sample or legal mapping studied in the paper.
